opening.text: I've come in because I have pain that came on slowly. It feels tender, and I'd rate it a 5 out of 10. I'm also quite short of breath, it's hard to breathe, and I've been coughing up blood. I've lost weight without trying over the last 3 months. I smoke cigarettes, and some of my family members have had lung cancer.
